messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Auto-alert: elevated 502/504 errors observed at edge proxy (us-west-2). 5m error rate 18% (baseline ~0.2%). Paging SRE oncall.

Maya: Got it, I'm oncall. Seeing alerts in Datadog too. Rolling 1m error spike starting 2026-03-14T10:00Z.

Kai: I'm joining. Starting with quick checks: any recent infra or config deploys in last 30m?

Maya: No infra deploys from infra-ci in last 60m. Product push around 09:45 but only app layer.

Ana: Copy. Looking at proxy pod counts and CPU. K8s shows 3/3 edge-proxy pods healthy, CPU and mem normal.

Maya: Logs: lots of upstream timeouts to service: model-router-usw2. Example from nginx error log: 
```
2026/03/14 10:02:15 [error] 12345#0: *98765 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.5.10, server: , request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.20.3.12:8080/", host: "api.redwood.ai"
```

Kai: That points to backend slowness leading to 502/504 at edge. Can we confirm backend error rate and latency?

Ana: model-router-usw2 SLO graphs: 90th latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s, error rate (5xx) from 0.1% -> 12%. Traces show TCP retries and increased queue depth.

Evan: Any network ACL changes? Cloud provider metrics show increased retransmits between edge and backend pool for a subset of hosts.

Maya: I ran curl against a healthy and a problematic backend IP:
```bash
# healthy
curl -sS -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}
' http://10.20.1.8:8080/health
# problematic
curl -sS -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}
' http://10.20.3.12:8080/health
```
Results: healthy ~200 0.09s, problematic ~504 2.1s (timeout).

Kai: Looks like a subset of backend instances are degraded. Mitigation options: 1) drain problematic backends from edge routing (fail fast), 2) increase backend capacity, 3) enable short-term routing to fallback pool (older model-router set), 4) add a rate-limit at edge to protect backend. I suggest draining first to reduce user impact.

Maya: Initiating drain of 10.20.3.12 and a handful of affected IPs from the backend pool via service registry. Command: `svc-registry mark-unhealthy model-router-usw2 10.20.3.12` (will remove from rotation within ~10s).

Zoe: Noted — sending customer alert draft to support. Impact: ~18% of requests in us-west-2 get 502/504, mostly non-Enterprise. Estimated affected customers: ~3% of active orgs making API calls now.

SupportBot: Draft alert saved to /alerts/us-west-2-502s.md. Ping @support if you want immediate broadcast.

Ana: After draining 4 IPs, edge 5m error rate down to 6%. Latency back to 240ms 90th. Some residual failures from retries.

Kai: Good. Let's keep rollout: continue draining any backend with >1s median response. Also scale model-router-usw2 replicas by +30% as precaution. `kubectl scale deploy/model-router-usw2 --replicas=9 -n inference`

Maya: Scaling started. Also toggling proxy retry policy to fewer retries to avoid amplifying load: updating config to 1 retry (was 2). Pushing change to edge-proxy config: `edge-config set retries=1 --env production`

Evan: Provider shows increased retransmit on subnet 10.20.3. Possible partial network degradation. Opening support ticket with cloud networking for their visibility. Ticket ID: CLOUD-45216.

Maya: Handing off active tracking to Kai (oncall till 12:00). I'll remain available. Kai — please coordinate final RCA and customer comms.

Kai: Taking over. Current status: error rate 3% (5m), scaling in progress, draining + retry change applied. Will monitor for 30m. If errors stable <0.5% after that, we can resolve.

Zoe: Support: creating status page incident and sending initial customer-facing message: "We are experiencing elevated 502/504 errors for some API requests in US-West. We are actively mitigating; no action required from customers." Draft will be updated with ETA after 30m.

Ana: Quick rollback note: if drains & scale don't stabilize within 10m, plan B = route traffic to fallback model-router-usw2-v1 pool (older instances) and enable temporary increased timeout at edge for premium customers only.

Kai: Monitoring dashboards: https://datadog.redwood.ai/dash/edge/502s (link), watch for spike in retries and backend 5xx. Will post last update at 2026-03-14T10:35Z.

Maya: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: Ana (network/backend analysis), Kai (mitigation timeline + ops), Zoe (customer comms).

Kai: Update 10:34Z: metrics stable, error rate now 0.4% 5m. Closing active mitigation in 10m and will transition to RCA tracking ticket REDWOOD-2387.

SupportBot: Incident status set to "mitigated" in /incidents. Follow-up: create RCA and attach logs/traces.

Zoe: I'll push final customer update once RCA ETA is known.

Maya: Great, thanks all.
